answers.core:
While this could be implemented as a plugin, it should ideally be part of the core engine. Accessing external `.txt`, `.json`, or other non-media files is a common need for many Android apps and games.

Adding SAF support directly in core would significantly improve Android file access, especially that use of MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is discouraged by Google.
answers.workaround: No, this can't be easily worked around. SAF requires platform-specific handling that are not accessible from GDScript alone without writing a custom Android plugin.

title: Android: Implement full Storage Access Framework (SAF) support
